subject: Orbit Analytics RFP: benchmark incentive / stacking policy question
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orbitanalytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@orbitanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood — benchmark participation + incentive question

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with your throughput and the tracing hooks. We're in finalizing the RFP for our internal benchmarking bake-off (teams: Redwood, AxiomAI, Cloudwire) and procurement asked me to clarify what incentives are available for a fair evaluation.

A few specifics:
- Timeline: benchmark runs between Apr 5–18, evaluation committee decision Apr 25.
- Expected usage: roughly 1.2M inference tokens total across several scenarios.
- Ask: can Redwood offer an evaluation credit or promotional top-up to help cover cloud/inference costs for the run? AxiomAI has already offered a $30k equivalent credit and Cloudwire is offering a 60-day trial plus credit.

Two questions from our side:
1) Is Redwood open to matching a competitive incentive in principle?
2) Do you allow stacking of platform credits (trial + promotional + custom allotment) for the same program, or do you limit to one credit type?

I attached the RFP overview (RFP_Orbit_Benchmark.pdf) — high level only. Happy to hop on a quick call to align.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement, Orbit Analytics
Samantha.Lee@orbitanalytics.com
+1 617-555-0142

Attachment: RFP_Orbit_Benchmark.pdf (pdf)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 18:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood — benchmark participation + incentive question

Team — forwarding Orbit's note. They explicitly called out competitor credits. They want to know if we can match and whether we allow stacking (trial + promo + bespoke).

My suggested approach:
- Offer a centered evaluation package vs a straight match. Proposal: $25k standard eval credit + $15k conditional top-up that vests if they run the benchmark within 60 days and sign an MoU (mutual action plan).
- Do not allow stacking of multiple third-party promotions; keep top-up conditional and earmarked for inference consumption only (to avoid transfer).
- Expire credits 90 days after grant.

I attached a brief draft of the terms (proposed-eval-terms-draft.pdf). Looking for quick feedback from finance/legal: is the $15k top-up ok as a conditional promotional allowance for this strategic opportunity? Also, any hard restrictions we should include by policy?

If approved, I'll propose the terms to Samantha and try to lock the timeline.

—Vivek
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-eval-terms-draft.pdf (pdf)
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood — benchmark participation + incentive question

Vivek — quick comments from finance: we can approve a $25k standard eval credit within current approval band. The additional $15k conditional top-up needs to be classed as a promotional expense and routed through marketing credits budget (not pure cost-of-goods).

Constraints / requirements:
- Promotional top-up must be time-bound and non-transferable.
- Credits must be limited to inference token spend (no other platform services).
- We require a signed MoU or mutual action plan that lists the benchmark dates and acceptance criteria before funds are disbursed.
- We should cap per-request usage rate to avoid burst abuse (document in MoU).

If marketing signs off on the $15k, finance can sign the paperwork; legal will need to review the MoU language.

Nikhil
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood — benchmark participation + incentive question

Approved with conditions — this is strategically sensible to chase Orbit (strong analytics reference and potential expansion). Final sign-off notes: 

1) Approve the $25k base eval credit + $15k promotional top-up (total $40k committed) if:
   - Orbit signs the MoU (we provide a template) and commits to running the benchmark between Apr 5–18.
   - The promotional top-up is disbursed only after they submit benchmark logs and an internal acceptance checklist (to prevent waste).

2) Credits expire 90 days after grant; promotional top-up cannot be stacked with any other vendor promotions. Trial credits that come from our self-serve onboarding are neutralized for this RFP (we will mark the HubSpot deal as "RFP - vendor credit" to avoid double-dipping).

3) Legal to add a clause: credits are for Redwood inference usage only and are non-transferable. Finance to code the top-up as marketing expense.

Vivek — go ahead and propose this structure to Samantha. Copy legal@redwood.ai and marketing-credits@redwood.ai on the MoU when you send it. Keep the HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/ORBIT-2027-03-BENCH-07

-Stephanie
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
